title: Newsletters
description: Product-update emails to your subscribers, made from the posts published since the last one.
pending: {count, plural, =0 {No new posts since the last email.} one {# post published since the last email.} other {# posts published since the last email.}}
subscribers: {count, plural, =0 {No subscribers yet} one {# subscriber} other {# subscribers}}
aiOn: Claude writes the draft. You review and edit it before sending.
aiOff: Drafts list each post's title and excerpt. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY so Claude writes them.
noSmtp: Email is not configured on this server (SMTP_URL), so newsletters can't be sent yet.
emptyDescription: When there are new posts, create an email and review it before sending.
generatingBody: This takes a minute. The page updates when it's ready.
failedTitle: The draft could not be written
subject: Subject
preheaderHint: Shown after the subject in most inboxes.
missingLanguage: No {language} version yet. Subscribers in this language get the default language.
removePostDescription: It will go in the next email instead. Remove its mention from the text yourself.
regenerateDescription: Your edits in every language are replaced by a new draft.
sendDescription: {count, plural, one {It goes to # subscriber} other {It goes to # subscribers}} now. This can't be undone.
deleteDescription: Its posts go back to the queue for the next email.
settingsDescription: Sender, footer and guidance for the AI writer. Emails are sent from the server's MAIL_FROM address.
footerHint: Company name and postal address, required by anti-spam laws in many countries.
aiInstructionsHint: Tone, audience, what to highlight or avoid. Used when Claude writes a draft.
skipReaders: Skip people who already read it
skipReadersHint: Don't email subscribers who already saw every post of the newsletter in the widget (needs identified users in Settings → Widget).
emailReaders: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has opened a post from this email yet.} one {# person opened a post from this email.} other {# people opened a post from this email.}}
skippedReaders: {count, plural, one {# subscriber who already read everything is skipped.} other {# subscribers who already read everything are skipped.}}
